question: Does a low-rank documents module learned from many varied phrasings generalise to new wording where L4, learned from 132 templated demonstrations, did not?
why: On confirmation 3, L4 scored 118/132 against the parent's 120 (claim deadlines 3/12 against 8/12): it learned the authored templates. L5 keeps L4's recipe and changes only the experience: 660 cases whose wording comes from 831 Bedrock-written templates (74-76 per kind), judged and disjoint from the sealed confirmation4 templates.

unit.name: L5
unit.layers: A2 layers and projections, rank and alpha

experience.documents: the documents solver's verified demonstration of every one of the 660 generated-train cases
experience.replay: the parent's own greedy chat replies on the 320 generated-train chat cases under the chat2 policy, replayed only where they pass

training.rule: A2 trainer settings for the low-rank module; terminal step only; no checkpoint selection. Same steps and mixture as L4, so each demonstration is seen about 2.3 times rather than about 11.6.

integration: parent and parent+L5 greedily on the 66 documents and 48 chat generated-development cases (templates held out of training) on the same GPU
next_gate: L5 advances to the sealed confirmation4 on the canonical CPU runtime only if, on generated-development, it solves more documents cases than the parent, loses no more than one chat case, and every minimum (documents 85%, chat 90%, not-found 90%) holds.
